The transition from head to body appears slightly abrupt and thickened, lacking the graceful, continuous taper expected in a slender elapid. The geometry feels slightly 'melted' or poorly defined at the connection point.

Some background branches have slightly inconsistent focus and geometry, appearing to warp or blend into the background in a way that suggests minor depth map errors, though this is less critical than the subject defects.
